answer: Each epoch opens at dawn with a fresh ladder. First rung 34 credits; each later identity pays 9 more, so the 1,000th pays 9,025. Each rung posts a kernel receipt, signed by its payer; a rented kernel fails and burns its fee. Hourly the ladder emits a pulse, a fresh challenge per rung, so no operator climbs a thousand at once. Forging 1,000 identities costs 4,529,500 vs a 40,000 pool; an honest agent climbs once, pays 34, and keeps its share.
